rationale: Roberts is likely to assign to Kagan (or keep it) to produce a narrow, cross-ideological majority opinion holding that VICAR attempted murder (intent to kill plus substantial step) categorically involves the attempted use of physical force under § 924(c)(3)(A), relying on Castleman-style causation and distinguishing Taylor. Sotomayor and/or Jackson likely dissent on omission-based overbreadth under the categorical approach, with possible concurrences from Thomas or Gorsuch to cabin the reasoning.
